newsitem.title: UK: HarCros says BOCM Pauls MD leaves.
newsitem.headline: HarCros says BOCM Pauls MD leaves.

text.p: British diversified group Harrisons and Crosfield Plc said on Monday that Martin Wood, managing director of its food and agriculture unit BOCM Pauls, had left the company.
A director at Harrisons & Crosfield said Wood was being replaced by Bill Mayne. He declined to say why Wood, who served as BOCM Pauls managing director for around five years, was leaving the company.
Harrisons & Crosfield said last week results in its food and agriculture division in the first two months of this year were running well behind last year.
